description: This file defines the IGrainRuntime interface, which provides the core runtime interactions for grains in Orleans, including access to silo identity, address, grain factory, timer registry, service provider, and methods for deactivation and storage management.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates the specified grain when it becomes idle.

methods.name: DelayDeactivation
methods.description: Delays the deactivation of the specified grain to prevent it from becoming idle.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage for a specific grain.
